associations.rationale: Its type directly states the source's conclusion that the polynomial representation of the Weyl algebra in characteristic p is not injective, hence is not faithful.

Its type says that y^p acts as zero in the polynomial representation; this is the intermediate kernel witness derived from vanishing of the p-th derivative, not the source's general derivative statement or final nonfaithfulness conclusion.
Its type directly states that the p-fold iterate of polynomial differentiation sends every polynomial Q to zero in characteristic p.
